title: Continuity on the probability interval
statement: The closed Gaussian profile, equal to the Gaussian isoperimetric profile on $(0,1)$ and zero elsewhere, is continuous on $[0,1]$.
replaced: Let $\Phi,\varphi$ be the standard Gaussian distribution function and density, and let $\overline I(p)=\varphi(\Phi^{-1}(p))$ for $0<p<1$, with $\overline I(p)=0$ elsewhere. The function $\overline I$ is continuous on $[0,1]$.
